description:
## Background

`oxlint.config.ts` and `oxfmt.config.ts` each define overlapping project ignore arrays for vendored skills and upstream source snapshots. The duplicated lists are accompanied by comments telling maintainers to keep them synchronized with Lefthook. This is a drift risk: a path can be ignored by one formatter surface and still be scanned by another.

The generated TauRPC binding at `src/rpc/bindings.ts` is intentionally ignored by the formatter but still linted with a targeted rule override.

## What to build

Create one repository-owned TypeScript module containing the shared ignore policy and make both oxc configurations consume it.

## Technical Approach

Add `quality.ignores.ts` with:

```ts
export const VENDORED_IGNORES = [
  "docs/research/infra/**",
  ".agents/skills/**",
];

export const FORMAT_ONLY_IGNORES = ["src/rpc/bindings.ts"];
```

Update:

- `oxlint.config.ts` to import and use `VENDORED_IGNORES`;
- `oxfmt.config.ts` to use both arrays;
- comments to identify `quality.ignores.ts` as the canonical lint/format policy.

Keep Lefthook `exclude` entries as trigger-level performance filters. They must not become a competing policy or diverge silently.

Do not add `scratch/**` without an explicit decision that personal scratch files are project-owned. The current scratch files are globally ignored local files and should be handled by clean-checkout verification instead.

## Considerations

- Do not edit `.agents/skills/**`.
- Preserve Ultracite’s existing built-in ignore patterns.
- Preserve the generated binding’s lint override and only remove its format processing.
- The new module itself must pass the project’s lint and format checks.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `quality.ignores.ts` is the only project-owned definition of the shared vendored and generated ignore arrays.
- [ ] `oxlint.config.ts` and `oxfmt.config.ts` import the shared arrays and have no duplicated `PROJECT_IGNORES` list.
- [ ] The effective tracked-file findings before and after the refactor are unchanged.
- [ ] `docs/research/infra/**` and `.agents/skills/**` remain excluded from both relevant oxc surfaces.
- [ ] `src/rpc/bindings.ts` remains excluded from formatting and retains its lint override.

## Test Plan

- Run `pnpm exec ultracite check` before and after the refactor from a clean checkout and compare findings.
- Run `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit`.
- Run the relevant config-loading command or `mise run check` after the mise task slice exists.
- Inspect Lefthook exclusions to confirm they remain trigger filters rather than a new source of policy.

## Triage

ready-for-agent
title: Centralize frontend quality ignores
